title: MythicWaveArena
description: Wave arena that spawns MythicMobs using configurable commands.
body:
# MythicWaveArena

Wave arena that spawns MythicMobs using configurable commands.

## Features
- Configurable wave list with delays.
- Uses a spawn command template for MythicMobs.
- Arena center + radius for randomized spawns.
- Broadcast messages per wave and on finish.

## Command
- `/mythicwaves setarena | start | stop | status | reload`

## Permissions
- `mythicwavearena.admin`
- `mythicwavearena.alert`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
spawn-command: "mm mobs spawn {mob} {amount} {world},{x},{y},{z}"
arena.radius: 8
wave-order:
  - wave1
  - wave2
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4
